Anant sinh ki beti ki shadi 25 navanbar ko hai. iske lie bhavy taiyari ki gaee hai. tarah-tarah ke vyanjan banae gae hain. shadi samaroh men kaee videshi mehman pahunchenge. is vidiyo men janie kya hai shadi ki taiyari...
